comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments) and any-comment binary/null rules, but different constructs. Feature 0 needs first-hand or personally situated details of how work is actually done or experienced (tasks, hours, tools, job steps). Feature 1 accepts any specific, concrete illustrative example, including hypothetical, non-labor or non-personal cases. Feature 1 is much broader. Feature 0 is a narrow subtype limited to labor and personal experience. The two also differ in their quote exclusions.
